name: Talkform
description: Talkform gives agents a project-scoped way to collect reviewed human answers through expiring text handoff links, with optional voice, and returns structured JSON.

skills.name: Run a guided interview
skills.description: Ask form questions one at a time over live browser audio or text and capture structured answers.

skills.name: Import a public form
skills.description: Read a public Typeform, Google Forms, Jotform, or HubSpot form URL and produce an editable Talkform draft config.

skills.name: Export structured results
skills.description: Export a completed interview session as JSON matching the AudioformSessionResult schema, or as Markdown.

skills.name: Create a hosted handoff
skills.description: With a project Bearer key, create an idempotent handoff, send a respondent a 7-day link, poll for a reviewed result, or delete the handoff.

skills.name: Register an agent workspace
skills.description: Register a machine workspace without an email or Clerk account and receive a one-time project key secret.

note: Informational discovery profile; it is not an A2A JSON-RPC endpoint. Agents can register a machine workspace with POST /api/v1/agents/register or talkform.register_agent, then use its Authorization Bearer project key. The one-time secret is never replayed. Hosted handoffs have 7-day links and 7-day completed-result access; signed completion webhooks are available through the HTTP API.
